facts: The shape of a dog’s face suggests how long it will live. Dogs with sharp, pointed faces that look more like wolves typically live longer. Dogs with very flat faces, such as bulldogs, often have shorter lives.
An estimated 1,000,000 dogs in the U.S. have been named as the primary beneficiaries in their owner’s will.
The process of birthing puppies is called "whelping."
It is not possible to know how many puppies a dog will have just by looking. The appearance can be very deceptive.
The tallest living dog is a Great Dane named Zeus, who measured 44 inches at the shoulder.
